title: Steadier on icy paths
headline: Steadier on icy paths
detail: A simple balance move to save
caption:
Frosty pavements this week? Strong ankles and calves help you feel steadier on your feet. ❄️

Try this slow calf raise at home:

1. Stand tall behind a sturdy chair or worktop, resting your hands on it lightly.
2. Rise onto the balls of your feet for a slow count of three.
3. Lower your heels for another slow count of three.

Do 10, rest, then do 10 more. When it feels easy, try resting just one hand on the chair.

Go at your own pace, keep holding on if you need to, and stop if anything hurts.
